question: Tell me about the POST /v1/speech-to-speech/{voice_id} endpoint.
ground_truth: The POST /v1/speech-to-speech/{voice_id} endpoint is the Voice Changer API that transforms audio from one voice to another. Path parameter: voice_id (required) - target voice ID. Query parameters: enable_logging (boolean), optimize_streaming_latency (integer 0-4), output_format (string). Request body (multipart/form-data): audio file to transform, model_id (e.g., 'eleven_multilingual_sts_v2'), voice_settings, seed (integer), remove_background_noise (boolean), file_format. Output formats include MP3, PCM, μ-law, A-law, and Opus variants. Response: 200 returns binary audio (application/octet-stream), 422 returns validation error. Authentication via xi-api-key header.
